parameter.name: Type
parameter.help: Choose how to represent the impedance

parameter.name: Ctrl
parameter.help: Choose how to control the source: fixed, external or automatic

parameter.name: ZSeq
parameter.desc: Zero Seq. Differs from Positive Seq. ?
parameter.help: Specify whether Zero sequence is different from Positive Sequence Impedance

parameter.name: Imp
parameter.help: Impedance data can be entered as RRL values or as impedance

parameter.name: Exph
parameter.help: External phase input can be entered in radians or degrees

parameter.name: View
parameter.help: Graphics could be displayed in either single line view or three phase view

parameter.name: Term
parameter.help: Parameters could be entred as in terminal or as in behind the source impedance

parameter.name: RN
parameter.desc: Harm. # where phase is same as fundamental

parameter.name: PS
parameter.help: Parameters could be entred as parallel or series values. However it will be modelled as equivalent parallel branches at specified conditions.

parameter.name: TcTyp
parameter.help: Select linear ramp or smoothed ramp through a real pole

parameter.name: Tc
parameter.help: Enter linear ramp up time or time constant of the realpole

parameter.name: VCtrl
parameter.help: Voltage could be controlled automatically to produce desired bus voltage

parameter.name: PCtrl
parameter.help: Phase angle could be controlled automatically to produce desired power output

parameter.name: P
parameter.error_msg: Name must begin with a letter and can contain only letters, numbers and _

parameter.name: Q
parameter.error_msg: Name must begin with a letter and can contain only letters, numbers and _

parameter.name: V
parameter.desc: Name for PU RMS Source Volts

parameter.error_msg: Name must begin with a letter and can contain only letters, numbers and _

script.segment: #BEGIN #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_2 CALL COMPONENT_ID(ICALL_NO,$#Component) #IF Zseq==1 && Imp==0 #IF PS==0 RVD1_1 = $R0p RVD1_2 = $L0p #ELSE CALL SER2PAR($R0s,$L0s*TWO_PI*$F,RVD1_1,RVD1_2) IF ($F .GT. 1.0E-32) THEN RVD1_2 = RVD1_2/(TWO_PI*$F) ELSE RVD1_2 = 1.0E6 ENDIF #ENDIF #ELSE RVD1_1 = 1.0 RVD1_2 = 0.1 #ENDIF CALL ESYS651_CFG(3,$Type,$Imp,$ZSeq,$Term1,$SS,~ #IF View==0 #IF A!=0 ~$BA,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF B!=0 ~$BB,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF C!=0 ~$BC,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF (ZSeq==1)&&(A!=0)&&(B!=0) ~$BABM,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF (ZSeq==1)&&(B!=0)&&(C!=0) ~$BBCM,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF (ZSeq==1)&&(C!=0)&&(A!=0) ~$BCAM, #ELSE ~0, #ENDIF #ELSE ~$BR(1),$BR(2),$BR(3),~ #IF (ZSeq==1) ~$BABM,$BBCM,$BCAM, #ELSE ~0,0,0, #ENDIF #ENDIF #IF Ctrl==2 + $F,$F,0.0,$Vm,0.0,0.0,$MVA,$Vm, #ELSE + $F,$F0,$Ph,$Es,$Pinit,$Qinit,$MVA,$Vm, #ENDIF #IF (Ctrl==3)&&(VCtrl==1) + $Vbase, #ELSE + $Vm, #ENDIF #IF Imp==0 + 1.0,80.0,2.0, #IF (Type==1)||(Type==4) + $R1s, #ELSE + 1.0, #ENDIF #IF (Type>=3) + $R1p, #ELSE + 1.0, #ENDIF #IF (Type>=2) + $L1p, #ELSE + 0.1, #ENDIF #ELSEIF Imp==1 + $Z1, #IF Type==1 + 0.0, #ELSEIF Type==2 + 90.0, #ELSE + $Phi1, #ENDIF #IF Type==4 + $RN, #ELSE + 2.0, #ENDIF + 1.0,1.0,0.1, #ENDIF #IF (ZSeq==1)&&(Imp==0) + 1.0,80.0,RVD1_1,RVD1_2) #ELSEIF (ZSeq==1)&&(Imp==1) + $Z0,$Phi0,1.0,0.1) #ELSE + 1.0,80.0,1.0,0.1) #ENDIF #ENDBEGIN #HARMONIC:1 #STORAGE STOR:65 RTCL:1 RTCF:15 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_2 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_3 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_4 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_5 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_6 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_7 ! 3-Phase source: $Name #IF Ctrl==0 || Ctrl==3 RVD1_1 = RTCF(NRTCF+12) RVD1_2 = RTCF(NRTCF+14) RVD1_3 = RTCF(NRTCF+13) #ELSEIF Ctrl==2 RVD1_1 = $EV RVD1_2 = $EF RVD1_3 = $EP #IF Exph==1 + *PI_BY180 #ENDIF #ENDIF CALL ESYS652_EXE($SS,~ #IF View==0 #IF A!=0 ~$BA,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF B!=0 ~$BB,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF C!=0 ~$BC,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF (ZSeq==1)&&(A!=0)&&(B!=0) ~$BABM,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF (ZSeq==1)&&(B!=0)&&(C!=0) ~$BBCM,~ #ELSE ~0,~ #ENDIF #IF (ZSeq==1)&&(C!=0)&&(A!=0) ~$BCAM, #ELSE ~0, #ENDIF #IF Ctrl==3 && VCtrl + $SS,$Loop:NA,$Loop:NB,$Loop:NC, #ELSE + $SS, $A,$B,$C, #ENDIF #ELSE ~$BR(1),$BR(2),$BR(3),~ #IF (ZSeq==1) ~$BABM,$BBCM,$BCAM, #ELSE ~0,0,0, #ENDIF #IF Ctrl==3 && VCtrl + $SS,$Loop:N(1),$Loop:N(2),$Loop:N(3), #ELSE + $SS, $N3(1),$N3(2),$N3(3), #ENDIF #ENDIF + $Mode, RVD1_2, RVD1_1, + $Tc, $TcTyp, + 1.0, 1.0, 1.0,RVD1_3, #IF (Ctrl==3)&&(VCtrl==1) + $Vdes, $Tvm, $Tvc, #ELSE + 1.0,0.02,0.05, #ENDIF #IF (Ctrl==3)&&(PCtrl==1) + $Pdes, $Tpm, $Tpc, #ELSE + 1.0,0.02,0.05, #ENDIF + RVD1_4, RVD1_5, RVD1_6, RVD1_7) #OUTPUT REAL P {RVD1_4} #OUTPUT REAL Q {RVD1_5} #OUTPUT REAL V {RVD1_6} #OUTPUT REAL Theta {RVD1_7}

#IF View==0 #IF ( A != 0 ) BA = $N $A BREAKER 1.0 #ENDIF #IF ( B != 0 ) BB = $N $B BREAKER 1.0 #ENDIF #IF ( C != 0 ) BC = $N $C BREAKER 1.0 #ENDIF #IF (ZSEQ==1) #IF ( A != 0 ) && ( B != 0 ) BABM = $A $B BREAKER 1.0 #ENDIF #IF ( B != 0 ) && ( C != 0 ) BBCM = $B $C BREAKER 1.0 #ENDIF #IF ( C != 0 ) && ( A != 0 ) BCAM = $C $A BREAKER 1.0 #ENDIF #ENDIF #ELSE BR = $N $N3 BREAKER 1.0 #IF (ZSEQ==1) BABM = $N3(1) $N3(2) BREAKER 1.0 BBCM = $N3(2) $N3(3) BREAKER 1.0 BCAM = $N3(3) $N3(1) BREAKER 1.0 #ENDIF #ENDIF
INTEGER Mode = Ctrl==3 ? (PCtrl ? (VCtrl ? 1 : 3) : (VCtrl ? 2 : 0) ) : 0 INTEGER Term1 = Ctrl==2 ? 0 : Term

Three phase voltage source :A Phase A :B Phase B :C Phase C :EV Voltage magnitude (L-L rms) :EF Frequency [Hz] :EP Phase (could be radians or degrees, depending on the setting under configuration) :Loop Remote bus connection :N Neutral connection :N3 3 phase terminal connection
